title: Choose the visual world for the HVAC template
question: Which world should turn Everwell Heating & Air into a reusable, conversion-focused landing page?

options.label: The Airflow Test House
options.lineage: air-balancing smoke studies and residential cutaway diagrams
options.thesis: The page makes invisible comfort visible as a controlled stream of air moving through the home.
options.viewport: A sectional home fills the screen while a blue airflow ribbon travels from the outdoor unit to a comfortable room; booking sits on the same measured path.
options.risk: The technical metaphor must stay warm and immediately legible to homeowners.

raised.raise: Every action and proof point registers against one continuous comfort path.
The airflow demonstration behaves like a live diagnostic, not a decorative illustration.
The conversion action gets the same decisive visual force as an industrial control.
Motion leaves a brief luminous memory that explains where comfort travels.

options.label: The Dispatch Wall
options.lineage: regional service dispatch boards, job tickets, and van-route maps
options.thesis: The company feels ready because every request visibly moves from call to confirmed visit.
options.viewport: A bold dispatch board shows one new service request being assigned to a local technician, with the booking form built into the job ticket.
options.risk: Its familiar operations language can feel more back-office than household comfort.

options.label: The Comfort Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope and HVAC diagnostic bench
options.thesis: Comfort becomes a signal that a skilled technician can stabilize in one visit.
options.viewport: A full-width diagnostic trace resolves from a noisy temperature swing into a steady comfort line beside one amber request-service control.
options.case: It strongly identifies with technical expertise, but the instrument language asks more interpretation from a homeowner.
options.risk: The dark diagnostic world can read as equipment software instead of a local service company.

options.label: The Calibrated Comfort Rail
options.thesis: Every service and action aligns to one exact household-comfort scale.
options.viewport: A charcoal continuum is crossed by precise service lines that bloom into content at one measured position.
options.case: The precision is compelling, but local-service meaning is too abstract for an urgent homeowner.
options.kept: One calibrated rail now governs the assigned page’s reading order.
options.risk: Abstract calibration can hide the human service promise.

options.label: The Repair Forge
options.thesis: Each service step lands with the certainty of a measured industrial strike.
options.viewport: One decisive before-and-after repair moment spans the page like a billet changing under force.
options.case: Trade strength is clear, but heat and force misrepresent cooling, care, and residential trust.
options.kept: The assigned CTA inherits the forge’s decisive visual weight.
options.risk: The metaphor feels aggressive for household service.

options.label: The Living Air Current
options.thesis: A visitor’s gesture reveals currents carrying comfort through a dark home.
options.viewport: Pointer movement reveals a glowing current from the HVAC unit through the rooms.
options.case: The airflow analogy is beautiful, but the night-sea world weakens local-company recognition.
options.kept: The assigned airflow leaves a short-lived luminous memory as it moves.

options.label: The Service Van Wrap
options.lineage: itasha panel graphics and racing sponsor strips
options.thesis: The whole page behaves like one unforgettable service van moving across city blocks.
options.viewport: Overscale service art crosses panel seams while a compact booking strip runs along the sill.
options.case: Vehicle recognition is useful, but the pop-culture grammar overpowers a flexible client template.
options.kept: The assigned layout uses seams as purposeful transitions between service zones.
options.risk: The personality is too specific to remain a coringa template.

options.label: The Technician’s Field Sampler
options.lineage: stitched alphabet sampler and progressive practice sheet
options.thesis: Service expertise unfolds in bands from diagnosis to finished comfort.
options.viewport: A vertical sequence stitches the company’s process into one tactile service record.
options.case: The progression is understandable, but craft textiles do not identify HVAC strongly enough.
options.kept: The assigned narrative progresses in complete, legible bands rather than repetitive cards.
options.risk: The handmade language can undermine technical authority.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished local HVAC landing page led by a friendly technician, a suburban home, and a prominent booking form.
canonCard.viewport: A two-column hero pairs a reassuring technician photo with headline, phone number, and appointment form.
canonCard.risk: It converts conventionally but is intentionally difficult to distinguish from competitors.
